title: Approval of a three (3)-year Contract with Rosenbauer Minnesota LLC: By joining Sourcewell Contract 082025-RSD, covering purchase of three 3000-gallon Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting vehicles for use
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 10 - 14]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a three (3)-year Contract with Rosenbauer Minnesota LLC: By joining Sourcewell Contract 082025-RSD, covering purchase of three 3000-gallon Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting vehicles for use at Los Angeles International, for aggregate cost not to exceed $8,000,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Three-year purchase of three aircraft rescue and firefighting vehicles for Los Angeles International Airport from Rosenbauer Minnesota through a Sourcewell contract, for up to $8 million.
